result:
**Verdict: PASS.** This covers DG5 round 6, candidate `sha256:3294f8fc…ba6d` (source `ad52a56`, 2191 files). I confirmed the candidate ID in the repository and in a full-history (non-shallow) disposable clone, and the commits after `ad52a56` touch only `docs/delivery/`.

**My open finding: F-DG5-124 (Medium, mandatory, REQ-S18-001) is CLOSED_VERIFIED.**
- **Demo database:** all 8 form-record export files (T14 and T01, CSV and JSON, en and ar) carry the label in their own language. I checked them through the API and also downloaded them with the real export buttons in the English and Arabic UI.
  - In each CSV, line 1 is exactly "Illustrative example — synthetic" (en) or "مثال توضيحي — اصطناعي" (ar), and line 2 is the header.
  - In each JSON file, `illustrativeLabel` holds the same text.
  - The data rows are unchanged from round 5 (T14 has 3, T01 has 6).
- **Production-initialized database:** the same 8 files carry no label row, and `illustrativeLabel` is null.
- **Other exports:** the only other export in the product is the report pipeline, and its demo label tests passed 12/12. D-178 leaves the B0004 provenance line out of these data exports because REQ-PB-001 asks for it only in report footers. I accept that reading.

**The full review re-ran green:**
- **Validators:** the historical checks for DG4, DG3, DG2 and DG1 and the DG5 register check all exit 0.
- **Source comparison against the playbook:** 0 failures, identical to round 5. The EN/AR screen texts also match round 5; the few differences come only from records my own probes created and from generated IDs.
- **Integration batch:** 42 files, 527/527 passed (round 5's 490 plus the 18 form-record and 19 new export-label tests).
- **Root acceptance e2e, production stack:** 30/30 on the first run.
- **Demo e2e:** 12/12 on the first run, including the twelve walkthrough steps done by the demo role users.
- **Production isolation:** no demo record or user exists in production, and demo seeding is refused there (exit 3, as designed).
- **Seed determinism:** two independent demo seeds this round give the same checksum `0a7fdc3f…37e4` as rounds 4 and 5.
- **Official claims:** the text scan finds only disclaimers, and no DG0–DG7 text in the product strings.

No run timed out, flaked or failed. Two probe tests were skipped by design, because the API checks run in the English project only.

The repair wave's CSS change (long titles wrap instead of widening the page) has no effect on content, values or labels. I accept D-163 to D-168, D-178 and D-179, and all 78 assigned requirements are met.

**New findings: none.**

**Disclosures:**
- My first plain clone filled the shared disk, so I deleted it. I re-cloned with full, non-shallow history, leaving out only `docs/delivery/test-evidence`, `handbacks` and `runs`, which the candidate manifest excludes. The candidate ID still matched exactly.
- The assignment asks for `round: 5` and its header names task "R5", but this is round 6. The validator rejects a record whose round doesn't match its directory, so I wrote `round: 6`.
- The register notes for REQ-S18-001 and REQ-PB-089 don't yet mention the export fix. That is documentation drift with no behavioural effect, so I recorded it as an observation, not a finding.

The disposable clone and scratch files have been removed.

Files are in `docs/delivery/`:
- `reviews/DG5/round-6/domain-reviewer.json` (17 checks; it validates against the review schema)
- `reviews/DG5/round-6/domain-reviewer.verifications.json`
- `test-evidence/DG5/domain/round-6/` (EN and AR screenshots for the UI checks)
